init.title: Aqara U200 options
init.description: **Real-time BLE state** holds one Bluetooth connection open so the lock's own push reports (open/close, and more) arrive instantly — the BLE-native way to see keypad/key/manual opens, no polling. **Background poll (hours)** reads battery + settings periodically: 0 = off (on-demand only, via the Refresh button). Every Bluetooth read costs a little lock battery and, on a shared proxy (e.g. ESPHome), a connection slot — keep the poll off or long if that matters.
